supersedes_nothing: job1/job2/job3 originals and the 16 leaf analyses are immutable evidence of their actual runs. This contract is a NEW SIBLING with an explicit disposition map. No original artifact was edited, re-run or overwritten.
independent_confirmation_status: job2 and job3 were NEVER independently confirmed. Nothing in this contract asserts that any job2 or job3 row is correct. Where a job2 quantity is carried it is labelled as a job2 output, not as a verified fact.
selection_policy: NO preferred endpoint, criteria version, time point, population or single-record-per-cohort algorithm is defined or approved. An unresolved choice stays unresolved.

source.network_access: none; no re-fetch of participantFlowModule, intervention back-pointers or any absent content

denominator_state.PRESENT: a Participants denominator with a positive integer count for this group
denominator_state.REPORTED_ZERO: a Participants denominator reported as 0 — RETAINED as a source fact, marked unusable for any proportion, NEVER treated as an observed zero-response cohort and never used as a divisor
denominator_state.ABSENT_NO_DENOMS: the measure carries no denoms block at all
denominator_state.ABSENT_NO_PARTICIPANT_UNIT: denoms exist but none uses the unit Participants
denominator_state.ABSENT_FOR_GROUP: a Participants denoms block exists but holds no count for this group id
denominator_state.ABSENT_EMPTY_VALUE: a count entry exists for this group but its value is empty
denominator_state.PRESENT_NONNUMERIC: a count entry exists but does not parse as an integer
denominator_state.NONPARTICIPANT_UNITS_ONLY: the only denominator units present are not Participants — a nonparticipant unit, a third state distinct from absent and zero

unresolved_states.SINGLE_OBSERVATION: exactly one source observation for this cohort key
unresolved_states.UNRESOLVED_MULTIPLE_ENDPOINT_CONSTRUCTS: competing measures name different endpoint constructs (ORR / BOR / DCR / CBR / response-category distribution). These are NOT interchangeable encodings of one endpoint and are not collapsed
unresolved_states.UNRESOLVED_MULTIPLE_TIME_FRAMES: competing measures report different time frames
unresolved_states.UNRESOLVED_MULTIPLE_ASSESSMENT_CRITERIA: competing measures name different response criteria or criteria versions
unresolved_states.UNRESOLVED_MULTIPLE_DENOMINATORS: competing measures report different Participants denominators
unresolved_states.UNRESOLVED_MULTIPLE_PARAMTYPE_OR_UNIT: competing measures differ in paramType or unitOfMeasure
unresolved_states.UNRESOLVED_MULTIPLE_OUTCOME_TYPES: competing measures differ in PRIMARY/SECONDARY/... type
unresolved_states.DUPLICATE_ENCODING_CANDIDATE: competing measures are identical on every preserved identity field — a genuinely duplicate encoding rather than a distinct outcome. Observed count: 0
unresolved_states.UNRESOLVED_NO_DISTINGUISHING_FIELD_FOUND: more than one observation and no preserved field separates them. Observed count: 0
unresolved_states.NO_OBSERVATION_USABLE_FOR_A_PROPORTION: no observation in the set has a positive Participants denominator with an explicit POSTED reporting status

conflict_findings.NO_CONFLICT_DETECTED: neither a single cohort nor any within-measure sum exceeds enrollment
conflict_findings.SINGLE_COHORT_EXCEEDS_ENROLLMENT__INTERN: one reported cohort is larger than the trial's registered enrollment. The conflicting fields are recorded; NO overlap is inferred, NO field is declared wrong, NO corrected enrollment is produced and nothing is clipped
conflict_findings.WITHIN_MEASURE_SUM_EXCEEDS_ENROLLMENT: the groups of ONE outcome measure sum above enrollment. This is a conflict between source fields, not proof that patients are shared
conflict_findings.WITHIN_MEASURE_SUM_EXCEEDS_ENROLLMENT__P: as above, and that measure contains a pooled/total group, so its groups are known not to be independent
conflict_findings.ENROLLMENT_ABSENT: the record carries no enrollment count

reporting_status_state.ABSENT_FIELD: the record carries no reportingStatus field. job2 dropped these; they are retained here as source facts, marked unusable, because a missing metadata field is a metadata gap, not evidence that data are absent

CHANGE-MAP-vs-job2.tsv.description: Disposition of every row of all four job2 artifacts. The originals are untouched evidence of their actual run; this file records what this contract does with each row and why.

ENROLLMENT-CONFLICT.tsv.description: Registered enrollment as recorded, alongside the largest single cohort denominator and the largest WITHIN-ONE-MEASURE denominator sum. No cross-measure sum is emitted; no enrollment is clipped, corrected or declared wrong.

GROUP-RELATIONS-pooled-parent-component..description: Pooled parent cohorts and the component cohorts of the same trial. component_sum exists ONLY to expose double counting against the parent; parent and components are the same people and are never added together.

LEAF-QB-harmonised-trials.tsv.description: The four LEAF-QB files harmonised to one schema (they were delivered with four different headers). Trial-level rows only.

LEAF-QC-harmonised-ties.tsv.description: The four LEAF-QC files harmonised to one schema; all 1,590 step-f tie rows.

LEDGER-measurement-cells.tsv.description: Class/category identity and the raw reported cell values for those observations. Identity and provenance only; category semantics, corrected denominators and numerators are OWNED BY THE SIBLING denominator/category component and are not decided here.

LEDGER-response-observations.tsv.description: One row per (trial, outcome measure, results group) for every measure whose title matches the job2 response-title boundary. NO selection: competing records are all present. Source fields are kept separate and are never merged into one endpoint.

RELATED-SETS-unresolved.tsv.description: One row per cohort key (trial, normalised results-group title): the explicitly related set of competing observations and its machine-readable unresolved states. selection_status is always NOT_SELECTED_BY_DESIGN.

RESULTS-GROUP-ID-REUSE.tsv.description: Every (trial, results-group id) whose id carries more than one distinct group title across that trial's outcome measures. Evidence that OGnnn is not a study-level cohort key.
